data.name: GoHome
data.detailed_description:
Take control of an old local regular who’s had a few too many in this little atmospheric pixel-art adventure. After being kicked out of the tavern into a biting winter blizzard, you must navigate the freezing, snow-covered streets to find your way home.

The journey isn't just about survival; your wife has called to report that Sam, your loyal (but wayward) cat, has followed you to the pub again. You’ll need to explore the town, complete small side missions for eccentric locals, and track down Sam before the cold gets too much.

Key Game-play Features:

* Dynamic Drunken Physics: Experience unique movement mechanics where every step is a struggle against the elements and your own balance.

* Survival Elements: Manage your hunger, thirst, and body temperature to stay alive in the sub-zero temperatures.

* Hazardous Environments: Navigate through deep snow and dodge fast-moving motorbikes and local bullies that roam the blizzard.

* Explore & Rescue: Track down your cat Sam across the snowy environment while helping out the strange characters you meet along the way.

Can you make it back to your front door before the blizzard wins?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 10, or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 600 series or AMD Radeon Vega)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (7th gen or later) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
